name: Frost Elemental
primary:
A frost elemental appears in front of you and follows you for 60 s. At most 2 elementals serve you at once: a third one replaces the oldest. It attacks monsters nearby and whoever fights you, and never harms you or your allies.
Walks next to you and fires fast ice shards every 1.3 s from up to 13 blocks:
• Damage 2 ❤ cold
• Cold 40: slows, freezes at 100 accumulated cold
• Chill for 3 s
self_description: The elemental appears right next to you.
